rows.resolution_note: p001 sentence 2 states that the genetic instruments used in the MR came from deCODE Genetics with N=35,559 for 4907 plasma proteins; the exact N 35,559 with the 4,907-assay panel matches the Ferkingstad 2021 row only (the other deCODE pqtl row has 35,892), the sentence describes the analysis dataset, and nothing in the passage conflicts.
rows.quote: Subsequently, MR and colocalization analyses were performed using genetic instruments for 4907 plasma proteins from deCODE Genetics (N=35,559) and 2940 plasma proteins from UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) (N=54,219).
